tools: Screen-reader name of the buttons beside the message box (attach, dictate, add a link).
box.label: Accessible name of the message box. A socio is an AI agent.
box.placeholder: Placeholder of the message box. {{name}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
send.stop: Button: stops the socio's (AI agent's) reply.
send.queue: Button: sends a message for the socio (AI agent) to read after the reply it is writing.
send.queue-after-reply: Tooltip of the queue button. {{name}} is the socio (AI agent); "it" is the message.
send.queue-after-step: Tooltip of the queue button. {{name}} is the socio (AI agent); "it" is the message.
queue-full: Too many messages wait for the socio. {{count}} is the most a chat can queue, {{name}} the socio's (AI agent's) name.
queued.after-step: When a waiting message is read. {{name}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
queued.after-reply: When a waiting message with files is read. {{name}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
queued.next-turn: When a waiting message is read. {{name}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
source.url: Accessible name of a field for the web address of the page the message is about.
source.add-hint: Tooltip. Keep “From <url>” as it is: it is the line added to the message, not a tag.
held.preparing: Why the message box can't send yet: the chat is still loading.
held.catching-up: Why the message box can't send yet: the chat is syncing a turn that ran elsewhere.
unsent.too-long: A message the server refused for its size.
unsent.thread-running: Another device or tab started a turn. A socio is an AI agent.
unsure.stopped: The person stopped waiting for the server; Socio is the product.
errors.context: The page or context this chat is about could not load.
errors.retry-context: Button on that error: loads the chat's context again.
errors.no-response: The AI runtime answered with nothing.
skills.menu: Screen-reader name of the menu of chat skills (commands typed after /).
skills.active: Note beside a chat skill (a command typed after /) that stays on. A socio is an AI agent.
skills.end: Button: turns off the chat skill that is on.
attachments.tray: Screen-reader name of the files attached to the message being written.
attachments.progress: An upload's progress; {{percent}} is a whole number from 0 to 100.
attachments.refused: {{status}} is an HTTP status code, such as 500.
attachments.too-big: {{name}} is a file name; {{size}} and {{max}} are file sizes, such as "3.4 MB".
attachments.too-many: {{name}} is a file name; {{count}} is the most files a message can carry.
attachments.remove-failed: {{name}} is a file name; {{reason}} is the server's error message.
name-suggestion.text: A card suggesting a name for the chat. <name> wraps {{name}}, the suggested name, in bold: keep the tags.
name-suggestion.field: Accessible name of the field for editing the suggested chat name.
name-suggestion.reject: Button: dismisses the suggested chat name.
name-suggestion.customize: Button: edits the suggested chat name before using it.
new.edit: Button on a new chat's welcome, for the socio's owner or an admin: opens the socio's settings. "Specialist" is what the product calls a socio set up for one kind of work.
new.connect.title: Heading of the card shown before text chat is set up. A socio is an AI agent; Space is a product noun.
new.starters.think: A suggested first message the person can click; it fills the message box with these words, so write it as the person would ask.
new.box: Screen-reader label of a new chat's message box.
new.after-setup: Placeholder of the message box before text chat is set up.
new.model: Screen-reader label of the model picker for a new chat.
new.start: Screen-reader label of the send button that starts the new chat.
